title: check() swallows spawn_blocking JoinError silently — no log, no comment
description: CredentialStore::check() returns false for both wrong-password and for a JoinError (i.e. bcrypt::verify panicking in the thread pool). A JoinError is a programmer error (the verifier panicked), not an auth failure. The outer .unwrap_or(false) silently treats it as 'auth failed', with no log line and no comment. A future maintainer debugging spurious auth rejections has no signal. Should add a comment or log at warn level on JoinError.
